+---
+## What
+Source: ../FoundationModelsDecision/plan.md section 7, R3, and decision D8.
+
+File: `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Core/ProfileDefinition.swift`.
+
+- Add `public static let defaultDecisionCandidates: [ModelRef] = ["Mapika/decider-4b-GGUF/decider-4b-v3-Q4_K_M.gguf"]`.
+- Add `public var decision: [ModelRef]`, with DocC: the candidates of the decision slot in preference order; when no candidate fits, the slot uses the flash model.
+- Add the parameter `decision: [ModelRef] = ProfileDefinition.defaultDecisionCandidates` to `init`, after `embedding`. The existing call sites (about 110) do not change.
+- Write `init(from:)` by hand, or use `CodingKeys` and a custom decoder: decode `decision` with `decodeIfPresent`. JSON with no `decision` key gets `defaultDecisionCandidates`. The encoder writes `decision`.
+- Do NOT add `.decision` to `candidatesBySlot` in this task. The `ModelSlot.decision` case comes in the R2/R6 task.
+- Update the type DocC (the slot list in the first paragraph).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `ProfileDefinition(name:description:standard:flash:embedding:)` gives `decision == defaultDecisionCandidates`.
+- [ ] JSON with no `decision` key decodes, and `decision == defaultDecisionCandidates`.
+- [ ] JSON with `"decision": []` decodes to an empty list, and a JSON round trip keeps the list.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Add tests in `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/CoreTypesTests.swift` (or a new `ProfileDefinitionDecisionTests.swift`): default by `init`; explicit list by `init`; decode with no key; decode with an empty list; encode then decode round trip.
+- [ ] Run `swift test` once. All tests pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #decision
\ No newline at end of file
